notes: attribution tiers are load-bearing, not advisory metadata.
dedicated: the range is operated by the provider and carries no unrelated third-party traffic. CIDR + port is sufficient.
loopback: a local inference runtime bound to a host-local address on a well-known port. Address + exact port is sufficient.
shared: the range is shared CDN or shared cloud front-end space. CIDR + port is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT; a shared match without harness corroboration MUST classify as unknown.

kind=control-plane entries are never emitted as network.inference_endpoint. They exist so an operator reading this artefact can see the endpoint was considered and deliberately excluded from inference attribution.

providers.provenance: Anthropic publishes a dedicated ingress/egress range for its API and web properties. Range confirmed live on host andy on 2026-09-15: 21 concurrent established sockets to 160.79.104.10:443 from a coding-agent cgroup.

OpenAI publishes no dedicated ingress range for api.openai.com; the endpoint is fronted by Cloudflare's shared anycast estate. The ranges below are Cloudflare's published IPv4/IPv6 list and therefore also serve millions of unrelated sites. They are tiered shared for exactly that reason and cannot identify OpenAI on their own.

Google Vertex AI and generativelanguage.googleapis.com are served from Google Cloud global load-balancer and Google edge space shared with every other Google and GCP-hosted service. Measured on host andy on 2026-09-15: 35.186.224.33:443 inside this space belongs to a Spotify cgroup, and 34.54.84.110:443 belongs to an Antigravity CLI cgroup. Both sit in Google ranges; only the second is inference. This pair is the empirical basis for the shared tier.
Gemini API front end. Shares the Google edge estate with Vertex; listed separately so the emitted endpoint identifier distinguishes the two products, not so the ranges differ.
Local Ollama runtime default bind. Loopback plus the reserved default port is an exact, non-shared signal: no other service on this host binds 11434.

vLLM / llama.cpp / LM Studio OpenAI-compatible servers conventionally bind loopback:8000. Port 8000 is also a common generic dev-server port, so this entry is tiered shared despite being loopback — corroboration by a harness cgroup is required before it is attributed as inference.

OpenBao is a secrets manager, not an inference provider. It is named in the SLCD-P4-2 card's provider list and is recorded here so the artefact shows it was considered. kind=control-plane means the detector never emits it as network.inference_endpoint; classifying a secrets-manager connection as model egress would be a fabricated finding.
